# AEGISLEX — PHASE 8, PART 2A
## Complete Localization Audit — Findings & Fixes

**Scope:** Text localization only (translation coverage / `lang.t()` usage).
RTL/LTR layout and CSS direction handling were audited in prior phases
(PHASE3/4/5 RTL-LTR reports) and are out of scope for this pass.

**Method:** Every `.html` template and every inline-template `.ts` component
under `src/app` was extracted and scanned for literal text nodes and
user-facing attributes (`placeholder`, `title`, `aria-label`, `alt`, `label`)
that were not routed through `LanguageService.t()`. Every flagged hit was then
manually verified against its source file and, where relevant, the component
that consumes it, to separate genuine defects from false positives (Material
Icon ligatures like `search`/`shield`/`close`, brand names like `AegisLex`/
`Saul`, and dynamic values such as URLs/percentages). All app routes were
cross-checked against `app.routes.ts` to confirm which pages from the request
list actually exist as distinct components versus being sub-views of another
page (e.g. there is no separate "Document Viewer" or "Documents" page —
document handling lives inside the Cases feature; "Error Pages" is the single
shared `not-found` component, which was already correctly localized).

---

## CONFIRMED DEFECTS FOUND & FIXED

### 1. Landing page — 0% localized (most severe finding)
`features/landing/landing.component.ts` / `.html` never injected
`LanguageService` and had **zero** `lang.t()` calls. Every nav link, hero
headline/subtitle, CTA button, the chat-preview mockup, all 6 feature cards,
all 3 "how it works" steps, all 3 testimonials, the CTA section, and the
footer were hardcoded English literals.

**Fix:**
- Added ~75 new translation keys under the `landing.*` namespace (English +
  Arabic) to `language.service.ts`.
- Converted `LandingComponent` to inject `LanguageService` and expose
  `features`, `stats`, and `testimonials` as `computed()` signals built from
  `lang.t()`.
- Rewrote `landing.component.html` to bind every visible string through
  `lang.t(...)`. Author names in testimonials (e.g. "Sarah Al-Mansouri") were
  left untranslated, consistent with how proper names are treated elsewhere
  in the app; their role/title text is translated.

### 2. Global error infrastructure — 100% unlocalized, live on every error path
`core/services/error.service.ts` is the app-wide error handling layer
(`ErrorMapper`, `ErrorService`, `GlobalErrorHandler`). Every HTTP status
default message, every `ErrorCode → message` mapping, and every toast shown
by `ErrorService.handle()` and `GlobalErrorHandler` was hardcoded English,
completely bypassing `LanguageService`. This is a live code path — it fires
on every failed request and every uncaught exception, regardless of the
selected UI language.

**Fix:**
- Added `error.toast.*`, `error.http.*`, and `error.code.*` translation keys.
- Added a `messageKey` field to `AppError` (the existing `message` field is
  left as-is — it is log-only, consumed by `LoggerService.error()`/
  `console.error`, never rendered to the user).
- Added `ErrorMapper.toUserMessageKey()`, which returns a translation key
  instead of literal text. `ErrorService` and `GlobalErrorHandler` now inject
  `LanguageService` and resolve all toast titles/messages through `lang.t()`.
- The legacy `ErrorMapper.toUserMessage()` (returns English text) is kept,
  marked `@deprecated`, for any external caller outside this scan's reach —
  it was previously called only from `ErrorService`, which has now been
  migrated to the key-based path.

### 3. Unsaved-changes guard — live native `window.confirm()` in English
`core/guards/unsaved-changes.guard.ts` (wired to the `register` and
`reset-password` routes) called `window.confirm('You have unsaved
changes...')` directly, bypassing localization entirely.

**Fix:** Added `common.unsaved_changes_confirm` key; the guard now injects
`LanguageService` (guards run in Angular's injection context, so this is
safe) and passes `lang.t('common.unsaved_changes_confirm')` to
`window.confirm()`.

### 4. Modal / Confirm / Alert dialog services — fully hardcoded
`core/services/modal/modal.service.ts` (`ConfirmDialogService`,
`AlertDialogService`) had hardcoded defaults and dialog copy: "Confirm",
"Cancel", "Delete", "Unsaved Changes", "Leave Page", "Session Expired",
"Sign In", "Access Denied", plus the delete/unsaved-changes/session-expired/
permission-denied message bodies.

**Note:** these services are **not currently wired to any template** — no
`ModalContainerComponent` renders `ModalService.activeModal` yet, so this was
unreachable in the running UI today. It is documented here, and fixed,
because the task scope explicitly includes "every component capable of
displaying text," and because leaving it hardcoded would silently reintroduce
an English-only defect the moment a container component is added.

**Fix:** Added `modal.*` translation keys; both services now inject
`LanguageService` and resolve all titles/messages/labels through `lang.t()`.
`delete()`'s item-name interpolation now uses `lang.t(key, [itemName])`.

### 5. Scale-of-justice decorative icon — hardcoded `aria-label`
`shared/components/scale-of-justice/scale-of-justice.component.ts` had a
static `aria-label="Scale of Justice"` on its SVG. This component is reused
on the landing page, auth screens, and elsewhere.

**Fix:** Added `common.scale_of_justice` key; the component now injects
`LanguageService` and binds `[attr.aria-label]="lang.t('common.scale_of_justice')"`.

---

## VERIFIED CLEAN (no defects — checked, not assumed)

- **`auth-validators.ts`**: contains intentional dual-path legacy English
  getters (`getEmailErrorHint`, `.label`) alongside key-based getters
  (`getEmailErrorHintKey`, `.labelKey`). Confirmed via full-codebase grep that
  every call site (login, register, forgot-password, reset-password,
  profile, password-strength, password-requirements) uses the **key-based**
  variants. The legacy getters are unused dead code, not a live defect.
- **`toast.service.ts` callers**: every feature component invoking
  `toastService.success/error/warning/info(...)` across cases, documents,
  reports, contracts, profile, and settings already passes `lang.t(...)`
  results — no hardcoded toast text found.
- **Cases / case-form / case-detail**: all `label:` definitions for status,
  priority, and type options resolve through `lang.t()`. `getStatusConfig()`
  / `getPriorityConfig()` are localized. The `cases.status.review` (badge)
  vs. `cases.status.under_review` (filter dropdown) is an intentional
  distinct pair, not a duplicate-key bug.
- **`insights.component.ts`**: the template binds to the localized
  `kpiItems` getter. A second, unused `kpis` signal exists with hardcoded
  English KPI labels — it is dead code (confirmed zero references in the
  template) and was left untouched per the "only fix confirmed, live
  defects" instruction. Flagging it here for visibility.
- **Guards / interceptors** (`auth.guard`, `guest.guard`, error/auth/loading
  interceptors): no user-facing literal strings found.
- **not-found, toast-container, password-strength, password-requirements,
  app-input, auth-error, auth-loading-button** (inline-template components):
  all confirmed already fully localized.
- Remaining flagged "text nodes" across the whole app after the fixes above
  are exclusively Material Icon ligatures (e.g. `search`, `close`,
  `arrow_back`) and brand/product names (`AegisLex`, `Saul`), both of which
  are correctly left untranslated.

---

## FILES MODIFIED

1. `src/app/core/services/language.service.ts` — added `landing.*`,
   `error.*`, `modal.*`, `common.unsaved_changes_confirm`,
   `common.scale_of_justice` keys (English + Arabic).
2. `src/app/features/landing/landing.component.ts` — full localization
   rewrite (computed signals).
3. `src/app/features/landing/landing.component.html` — full localization
   rewrite (every string via `lang.t()`).
4. `src/app/core/services/error.service.ts` — `messageKey` on `AppError`,
   `toUserMessageKey()`, `ErrorService`/`GlobalErrorHandler` now use
   `LanguageService`.
5. `src/app/core/guards/unsaved-changes.guard.ts` — localized
   `window.confirm()` message.
6. `src/app/core/services/modal/modal.service.ts` — `ConfirmDialogService` /
   `AlertDialogService` fully localized.
7. `src/app/shared/components/scale-of-justice/scale-of-justice.component.ts`
   — localized `aria-label`.

No validation logic, AI logic, graph behavior, or mock/demo architecture was
modified. No files outside the seven listed above were changed.
